name: The Westin Maui Resort and Spa
insider_take: This oceanfront paradise sits on legendary Ka'anapali Beach, where ancient Hawaiian royalty once played - and those same pristine waters still beckon today.
whats_special: The resort features five interconnected pools including a 128-foot waterslide that winds through lush tropical landscaping, plus it's home to the only spa on Ka'anapali Beach. The property sits on sacred grounds where Hawaiian ali'i (royalty) held court centuries ago, adding cultural significance to every sunset.
pro_tip: Book a beachfront room on floors 4-6 for the perfect balance of ocean views and privacy from the pool activity below. The nightly torch lighting ceremony at 6 PM is a must-see cultural experience that's completely free.
dont_miss: Snorkeling at Black Rock (Pu'u Keka'a) right on the property - this ancient volcanic outcropping is considered one of Maui's best snorkel spots and holds deep spiritual significance as a sacred jumping-off point for souls in Hawaiian tradition.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Ka'anapali Beach
Multiple pools including aquatic playground with waterslides
Full-service Heavenly Spa for relaxation and wellness
Extensive dining options and resort amenities
cons: Large resort with busy common areas
Premium pricing for dining and resort services
